entries.rationale: Tailwind 3 build dependency. Vulnerable braces execution observed only during trusted production compilation using repository-controlled content globs. No execution in backend, worker, Nginx runtime or inspected browser artifact. Production users cannot control the patterns supplied to braces. Reviewed 2026-10-11 for the shared closure GitHub verifier binding: only the read-only verifier dependency, explicit hosted workflow-token bindings and mocked consumer regression tests change. Frontend source, dependency locks, runtime packaging and build patterns are unchanged; canonical browser closure and runtime packaging were independently revalidated against the retained unfiltered hosted OSV report.
